reviews.title: Rebel Inc
reviews.description:
This is one of my favorite games by Ndemic Creations.

When I finally completed a playthrough on Brutal difficulty—the highest difficulty available in the free version—it genuinely felt like I'd just won a real battle. The sense of accomplishment was incredible.

Earlier on, though, I struggled because I hadn't taken the time to learn the game's tactics and strategies, so I kept losing on the later maps.

Even so, Rebel Inc. remains one of my favorite games, right after Plague Inc., because the two games have completely different art styles while both offering unique and engaging gameplay.

reviews.title: Tiny Desires
reviews.description:
This is an excellent game to kill time, thanks to its minimalist yet incredibly addictive gameplay.

The core gameplay loop is highly accessible: you just need to drag the matching items to the creature based on the given conditions.

Notably, the game is very well-optimized, allowing lower-end devices to enjoy a smooth experience.

reviews.title: Lensko - Let's Go!
reviews.description:
This is one of my all-time favorite songs from NCS.

The opening beat is so perfectly crafted that it immediately makes me want to move. 

However, the biggest surprise lies near the middle, where the music transitions and transports me into another dimension. I don't know what instrument the producer used, but it creates a mesmerizing, echoing sound.

On top of that, the track brings back a wave of nostalgia from 2017. It’s a truly indescribable feeling...
